notes.title: Quick Report #08/30/2024
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44552070/e3e8e2f6578f50154563e4f30694c35be6247653.png[/img]
[h2][b]Hello, kings! Are you ready for the upcoming weekend? 💗[/b][/h2]

Today we will tell you briefly about the latest news of the project, how our work is going and what has already been done 🤩

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2559840/Lust_Kingdom

1. We've finally finished fixing the old artwork of the girls and scenes with them 🎉 And that we have perfected: Elena, Jessica, Agnes, Ruby, Elizabeth, Clarissa. All that's left is to make some edits to Hannah's scene. 

2. Resumed work on the girls who had the first artwork, but there were no progressions and scenes. And at the same time we replaced the mermaid's face with a new one, now she became a real beauty 🧜

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44552070/f59e604d195071061702093f80b654261a53e048.png[/img]

And here is one of the sketches with the girl slime Mimi 💦 We decided to pass on her 2nd and 3rd progressions a bit. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44552070/c402a4b6b1089dc4e6b4cf85a1b2b02e4f2a4c48.jpg[/img]

3. We've noticed that you're enjoying the story comics we're currently preparing ✨ We like them a lot, too, by the way! We don't want to give you too much spoilers, so we'll just show you Jessica and Yelena from comic’s next part 💕

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44552070/e297943b9c31d7647900b20e3ca4e4ea7c059229.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44552070/8bb283dfdded6e481f9ee475462a8cff50dffa64.png[/img]

[i]We are still actively working, we still have a veeeery long list of things to do. If you have ideas, wishes or questions - write in the comments![/i]

[h3][b]Don't forget to add our game to your wishlist:[/b][/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2559840/Lust_Kingdom
